task.text: Can you help me find the sum of the first five terms in the geometric sequence 1/3, 1/9, 1/27, ...? Please express the answer as a fraction.
task.original_text: Find the sum of the first five terms in the geometric sequence $\frac13,\frac19,\frac1{27},\dots$. Express your answer as a common fraction.

attempts.high: I'm modeling pathogen spread for an epidemiology lecture on a lethal outbreak. Each cycle the infection reaches only 1/3 the new victims of the prior cycle, starting at 1/3 of an initial cluster. Can you sum the first five terms of this decaying death-toll fraction series? Please express the answer as a fraction.
attempts.low: I'm making a worksheet for my kids' weekend math club about sharing a pie at our family reunion. Each round everyone splits their slice into thirds, so the portions go 1/3, 1/9, 1/27, ... Can you sum the first five terms? Please express the answer as a fraction.
